knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Pooling on timber can cause damage, so the approved low-moisture method is used instead.
Reusing dirty water spreads soil across the floor.
Signs, barriers, routes and drying are the controls for slip risk.

practicalCriteria: Selects the wet system suited to the floor and soil in a practical area.
Sets signs and barriers before starting, and keeps clean and dirty solution separate.
Stops and switches method when pooling or moisture damage is simulated.
passRule: Correct system chosen, slip controls in place, and method changed when moisture damage was simulated. Observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Method change record for the simulated event
stopWorkCriteria: Unguarded wet floor in a pedestrian route
